import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Biju Patnaik Airport location (Bhubaneswar Airport)
airport = ee.Geometry.Point([85.8180, 20.2440])
saheed_nagar = ee.Geometry.Point([85.848691, 20.290813])

# 2. Data Acquisition
# VIIRS Nighttime Day/Night Band - Monthly composites
viirs = ee.ImageCollection("NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG")

# April 2019
april_col = viirs.filterDate('2019-04-01', '2019-04-30')
print(f"April 2019 images: {april_col.size().getInfo()}")

# May 2019
may_col = viirs.filterDate('2019-05-01', '2019-05-31')
print(f"May 2019 images: {may_col.size().getInfo()}")

if april_col.size().getInfo() == 0 or may_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("Missing data for one or both months.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Get first (only) image from each month
    april_img = april_col.first()
    may_img = may_col.first()
    
    # 3. Extract brightness values at both locations
    # Airport - April
    airport_april = april_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=airport,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
    
    # Airport - May
    airport_may = may_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=airport,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
    
    # Saheed Nagar - April
    saheed_april = april_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=saheed_nagar,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
    
    # Saheed Nagar - May
    saheed_may = may_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=saheed_nagar,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
    
    # 4. Validation
    if None in [airport_april, airport_may, saheed_april, saheed_may]:
        print("Calculation failed - None values returned.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        # Calculate decreases
        airport_decrease = airport_april - airport_may
        saheed_decrease = saheed_april - saheed_may
        
        print(f"Airport April: {airport_april:.4f}, May: {airport_may:.4f}, Decrease: {airport_decrease:.4f}")
        print(f"Saheed Nagar April: {saheed_april:.4f}, May: {saheed_may:.4f}, Decrease: {saheed_decrease:.4f}")
        
        # 5. Final Answer
        if airport_decrease > saheed_decrease:
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
